headline: Sensex zooms 800 points as record foreign inflows and lower oil prices drive market rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Record foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows fueled a strong surge in Indian equities.
Softening crude oil prices contributed to positive market sentiment.
Strong buying in key heavyweights like Asian Paints and SBI boosted benchmark indices.
Indian markets demonstrated resilience, opening higher despite global market sell-offs.
whatHappening: Sensex surged 800 points intraday while Nifty rose past the 25,400 level.
Asian Paints extended gains to feature among the top gainers alongside SBI.
FII inflows continued to drive a robust November surge across domestic stock markets.
UBS noted that stock market valuation premiums face tests from tight interest rates and slowing growth.
summary:
Indian stock markets rallied strongly today, with the Sensex jumping 800 points intraday and Nifty topping 25,400.
Record FII inflows and supportive oil prices served as primary drivers for the continuous market surge.
Top gainers during the session included Asian Paints and SBI as broad-based optimism lifted domestic equities.
